items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bob Dylan giving Mose Allison a copy of his first album and giving the interviewer a ride, but Mose Allison does not confirm personal interaction or a specific relationship with Dylan in his responses.

ctx.x: Well, I used to work in Boston a lot, at the Jazz Workshop, on Boylston. I remember that.

Do you remember in Manhattan when Bob Dylan came...before he was famous, he came to see you and gave us a copy of his first album? I remember I played it to some people, and they said, “It sounds like country music to me.” Do you remember that?
